question: Which of the following states has become the first in India to use face recognition linked to Aadhaar for ration delivery in July 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Himachal Pradesh** has achieved a significant milestone by becoming the **first state in India** to implement **Aadhaar-linked face recognition** for the delivery of rations under the **Public Distribution System (PDS)** in **July 2025**.
 
• The initiative utilizes the **Aadhaar FaceRD (Face Recognition Device)** technology, which was developed by the **Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI)** to provide a secure and contactless authentication method.
 
• This system is specifically designed to assist **beneficiaries** such as the **elderly** and **manual laborers** whose **fingerprints** may have faded or become difficult to scan due to age or physical work.
